_doc: Presentation figures of the world view (game/ only, no rule reads them). GDD 4.15 gives the day/night colours; the rest is provisional greybox (H1) until the art arrives. zoom_levels: only values that keep pixels whole (D2). tint_strength: how far the phase colour pulls from white (1 = the raw colour, too dark for #1A1A40 at night). transition_minutes: game minutes a phase takes to blend in from the previous one.

character._badge_doc: H4: employees carry a diamond over the head in the colour of the family they work for; gold border (badge_own_border) when it is the player's family.

buildings._doc: H2 greybox of the buildings of state.buildings on the map (by type): block colour and height, sign and door colours. H4: sign_mode = "hover" shows the sign only while the mouse is over the building or it is picked (the houses: the town is not full of signs).

services._doc: H3 greybox of the market stalls and the contract board on the map: sign colours (the blocks are the map's stall/board tiles).

notices._doc: H3: urgent notices pop up over the HUD for popup_seconds (at most popup_max at once); severity colours of the notices log.

new_game._doc: H3 new game screen (GDD 4.16): the start offered (data/starts/) and the family colours to pick from (4.10.9; provisional palette from the style bible's base tones).

interior._doc: H2 greybox interior (GDD 4.6.4): zoom, fade (in+out, seconds), kit colours and heights, station blocks, the master-touch blink.
